adjudication.rationale: The finding is correct: `EmbedController#best` does not instantiate `TopicRetriever` at all when `topic_id` is nil; it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, user_id: ..., embed_url: ...)` and renders `loading`. However, `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` (the “tells the topic retriever to work...” example) expects `TopicRetriever.expects(:new)` and `retriever.expects(:retrieve)`. That expectation will never be met given the controller code in this diff, so the spec is incorrect/out-of-sync and would fail. It’s also true that the new `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` job has no dedicated spec to verify the argument/behavior contract, though the primary verifiable defect here is the mismatched controller spec.
